references.text: Describes the priest's examination of leprosy where the hair has turned white and the sore appears deeper than the skin, using the same diagnostic criteria as in verse 25.
The immediate context describing a burn on the skin with a white or reddish-white spot, which verse 25 continues to diagnose.
A parallel diagnostic procedure where the priest declares a person unclean due to leprosy when the sore appears deeper than the skin and the hair has turned white.
